SELECT pc.id AS customerId, pc.name AS childName, pc.birth_date AS childBirthDate, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS childAge, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS childAgeMonth, parent.integrated_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, parent.name AS parentName, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, parent.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS parentAge, parent.phone AS parentPhone, parent.address AS parentAddress, pc.gender AS childGender, pc.relationship_code AS relationCode, relation_code.code_name AS relationName FROM potential_customer pc INNER JOIN integrated_customer parent ON parent.integrated_customer_id = pc.parent_customer_id LEFT JOIN common_code relation_code ON relation_code.group_code = 'RELATIONSHIP' AND relation_code.code_value = pc.relationship_code WHERE #{conversionStatusCode} = '01' AND pc.id = #{customerId} AND pc.is_active = FALSE
UNION ALL
SELECT child.integrated_customer_id AS customerId, child.name AS childName, child.birth_date AS childBirthDate, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS childAge, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS childAgeMonth, parent.integrated_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, parent.name AS parentName, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, parent.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS parentAge, parent.phone AS parentPhone, parent.address AS parentAddress, child.gender AS childGender, NULL AS relationCode, '보호자' AS relationName FROM integrated_customer child LEFT JOIN integrated_customer parent ON parent.integrated_customer_id = child.parent_id WHERE #{conversionStatusCode} = '02' AND child.integrated_customer_id = #{customerId} AND child.birth_date > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 21 YEAR)

SELECT wr.id AS webFormId, wr.height, wr.weight, wr.selected_priority_category AS selectedPriorityCategory, wr.history_json AS historyJson, wr.activity_json AS activityJson, wr.past_surgery_or_hospitalization AS pastSurgeryOrHospitalization, wr.desired_budget_code AS desiredBudgetCode, wr.received_at AS receivedAt FROM webform_response wr WHERE wr.id = #{webFormId}

SELECT cgs.age AS ageMonth, cgs.height_p5 AS heightP5, cgs.height_p50 AS heightP50, cgs.height_p95 AS heightP95, cgs.weight_p5 AS weightP5, cgs.weight_p50 AS weightP50, cgs.weight_p95 AS weightP95 FROM cdc_growth_standard cgs WHERE TRIM(cgs.gender) IN ( #{gender}, CASE #{gender} WHEN 'MALE' THEN 'M' WHEN 'FEMALE' THEN 'F' ELSE #{gender} END ) AND cgs.age BETWEEN #{minAge} AND #{maxAge} ORDER BY cgs.age

SELECT cds.disease_code AS diseaseCode, cds.disease_name AS diseaseName, cds.treatment_type AS treatmentType, cds.patient_count AS patientCount, cds.rank_by_age_gender AS `rank`, category.category_code AS categoryCode, category.category_name AS categoryName, coverage.coverage_name AS coverageName FROM cdc_disease_statistic cds LEFT JOIN insurance_coverage coverage ON coverage.id = cds.target_coverage_id LEFT JOIN insurance_category category ON category.category_code = coverage.category_code WHERE cds.data_year = ( SELECT MAX(latest.data_year) FROM cdc_disease_statistic latest WHERE TRIM(latest.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} ) AND TRIM(cds.age_group_code) = #{ageGroupCode} AND (cds.gender = #{gender} OR cds.gender = 'ALL') AND cds.treatment_type = #{treatmentType} ORDER BY CASE WHEN cds.gender = #{gender} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cds.rank_by_age_gender, cds.patient_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
